author: Tayohn
quote: A true masterpiece and easily my 2026 GOTY. Capcom nailed the balance between pure survival horror with Grace Ashcroft and brutal, visceral action with a veteran Leon S. Kennedy. Returning to Raccoon City for the 30th anniversary feels deeply emotional and respectful to the franchise's roots, not just cheap fan service. Being able to switch between first and third-person at any time makes the replayability insane. While other overhyped games forgot how to be fun, Capcom delivered a dense, terrifying, and unforgettable single-player experience
